##### Project general facts

Gate Eleven Residences stands as a premium development comprising four adjacent buildings that are deliberately positioned to capture uninterrupted lagoon vistas while delivering an elevated aura of exclusivity. The architecture celebrates contemporary elegance, intertwining refined craftsmanship with sustainable design principles, and each interior space balances sophisticated aesthetics with practical functionality. An emphasis on high‑quality construction and innovative urban planning also establishes a new benchmark for administrative environments within the region.  

The community incorporates a fully integrated smart‑home system that enhances everyday convenience, while the lagoon‑facing terraces provide private outdoor extensions for residents. Thoughtfully arranged communal areas foster a family‑friendly atmosphere, supporting both relaxation and social interaction. The development’s layout ensures that every residence benefits from natural light and seamless connectivity to shared amenities.  

Interiors are finished with modern detailing and premium materials, creating a cohesive and polished environment. Kitchens come fully equipped, featuring a built‑in gas hob with hood, a gas oven, a microwave, a washer‑dryer unit, a dishwasher, as well as a fridge and freezer, with an additional full freezer available in two‑bedroom homes. No additional furnishing is provided, allowing occupants to personalize their living spaces.  

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan occupies a central position within Dubai, blending upscale living with convenient access to the city’s core arteries and cultural hubs. The district is celebrated for its polished streetscapes and proximity to major business corridors, ensuring effortless commutes and vibrant urban experiences. Residents benefit from a harmonious mix of contemporary infrastructure and tranquil surroundings that define the area’s appeal.  

At the heart of the community lies the iconic Meydan Racecourse, renowned for staging the prestigious Dubai World Cup and drawing a global audience of racing enthusiasts. The venue infuses the neighbourhood with an electric ambience, offering spectators the thrill of high‑stakes events just steps from their homes. This dynamic setting enriches daily life with a sense of excitement and distinguished heritage.  

Meydan’s landscape is dotted with extensive parks, meticulously landscaped gardens, and tree‑lined boulevards that invite leisurely strolls, cycling outings, and leisurely picnics. These verdant spaces serve as natural gathering points, encouraging outdoor recreation and fostering a close‑knit community spirit. The abundance of open areas provides a refreshing counterpoint to the bustling cityscape, enhancing overall wellbeing for residents.
